The quality-room.svg, quality-room.png and quality-empty.png fixtures were
created for this repository on 2026-10-25 and are dedicated to the public domain
under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

They are synthetic diagrams, not photographs. They contain no personal room
images, people, logos or third-party image assets. The gold boxes are derived
from the authored geometry and manually checked against the rendered PNG.

The fixed evaluation inventory is shelf, book group, oven-like appliance,
clothes rack and two clocks. Shirt silhouettes are decorative contents of the
rack and are outside this inventory. Desk and sofa are absence controls.
